Kevin Byrd is a self-taught abstract expressionist artist based in New York.

I’ve had the pleasure of being a part of the Ossining music scene performing with my jazz quartet at Jazz at the Lodge and presenting my Joni Mitchell and Paul Simon show with the amazing Peter Calo and John Lissauer at the Westchester Collaborative Theater, as well as performing here at BAC. My more recent passion has been iPhone photography. I’ve always loved all things nature and started there, taking photos of leaves and trees and skyscapes but then, through walks around my neighborhood, I started becoming increasingly drawn to the beauty of the details of scenes right outside my door from cracks in the sidewalk to dew-covered flower petals.
